_comment: exact = whole-string overrides; terms = names protected/translated inside sentences (whole words; single words are case-sensitive, terms of two or more words also match all lower case or with only the first letter capitalized). Policy (Brazilian Portuguese, same as Italian): proper names and names invented by GW2 stay in English (people, places, factions, skills, traits, boons, conditions, stats and their combinations); common objects and concepts are translated, one name for each thing. Base glossary: weapons, rarities, bags, siege, crafting disciplines, stat and duration lines; everything else still in English, to be extended. patterns = whole-line rules, {X} = the prefix words or a number.

advice.ascended: The adjective "ascended" (an item rarity) is "ascendido", agreeing in gender and number with its noun: "ascended armor" = "armadura ascendida", "ascended weapons" = "armas ascendidas", "ascended rings" = "anéis ascendidos".
advice.Focus: "Focus" as an item is the off-hand weapon: "Foco" (plural "Focos"), "focus skills" = "habilidades do Foco". As a verb ("focus on") translate it normally ("concentre-se").
advice.staff: "Staff" as a weapon is "cajado" ("o cajado", plural "cajados"). When "staff" means the people who work somewhere, translate it as "equipe".
advice.glider: "Glider" (the equipment used for gliding) is "planador", plural "planadores".
advice.skin: "Skin" of an item stays "skin" (feminine: "a skin", "as skins"): "weapon skins" = "skins de armas", "This will unlock the skin in your wardrobe" = "Isto desbloqueia a skin no seu guarda-roupa".
